input.overview: Farfalla links its red, yellow, and blue target groups to three Special ladders and REACT outlane protection. Complete all three colors, then hit the Multi Special target for the combined award. On the upper level, knock down every yellow target before the ball leaves to light the upper-left Special. Spell L-O-V-E for Bonus X, and use the Special Bonus collect when lit to take the accumulated bonus and advance Multi Special.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the red, yellow, and blue target groups, then hit Multi Special after all three colors are ready. Clear all yellow targets during one upper-playfield visit for the upper-left Special. Spell L-O-V-E for Bonus X, and take the lit Special Bonus collect for the stored bonus.
input.summary: Stay with the color group closest to completion. Finish all three colors before shooting Multi Special, and use a controlled upper-playfield visit to clear yellow targets without leaving early.

steps.text: Complete the red, yellow, and blue target groups to advance their Special ladders and light REACT.
After all three colors are complete, hit the Multi Special target to collect the combined award.
On the upper playfield, knock down every yellow target before the ball leaves to light the upper-left Special.
Spell L-O-V-E to advance Bonus X; take Special Bonus when lit to collect the built bonus and advance Multi Special.

steps.text: Complete the orange three-bank to advance Orange Special.
Return to the color groups when one is within a safe completion.
Complete each color group rather than spreading hits evenly across all three.
